sources.notes: Both target URLs returned 404. No Supernova Solution or Supernova Solution 2 review listing found in RTINGS running-shoe index.

keyFindings: Weight listed: 9.4 oz (266 g) men’s US 9; 8.5 oz (241 g) women’s US 8.
Stack listed: 36 mm heel / 26 mm forefoot, 10 mm drop.
Performance summary: PEBA-based Dreamstrike+ midsole gives controlled bounce; shoe handled daily runs through workouts, especially strong for easy and long runs.
Stability summary: mild guidance from dual-density support rods, wider midfoot, and heel geometry; forefoot behaves more neutral.
Overall recommendation: good option for runners wanting mild stability with PEBA foam for daily training and some uptempo work; may be insufficient for runners needing higher stability control.

basicFindings: Reported approx weight around 10 oz (US9) and full stack 35/25 mm with 10 mm drop.
Positive notes: energetic Dreamstrike+ cushioning, mild support via lower support rods, roomy comfortable upper, smooth beveled heel transition.
Negative notes: midfoot can feel rigid/flat at slower paces; upper may be too relaxed for stronger pronation control needs.
Reported weight 10.3 oz (292 g) men’s US 9.5 and stack 36/26 mm (10 mm drop).
Review highlighted subtle, non-intrusive stability and good daily-trainer comfort/durability.
Critiques included heel lockdown issues and outsole/upper concerns; conclusion framed it as good daily workhorse rather than standout.
